feeding_claim.verbatim: Finally, the herd is finished on grain for the final 5-6 months

farmers_markets: Historic Lewes Farmers Market, George H. P. Smith Park, Lewes (Saturday)
notes: Black Angus raised on Sudangrass after weaning, then grain-finished for the last 5 to 6 months, dry-aged 21 days. Farm pickup at the Frankford farm by appointment. Ships via FedEx Ground for a flat fee, but the site names no shipping area. Where to Buy page still shows 2019 market dates; the 2026 Historic Lewes Farmers Market vendor page still lists the farm. Lloyd's Market in Lewes carries some steaks and takes farm orders for pickup. 1/8, 1/4 and 1/2 steer packages are mentioned but that section was marked under construction. Hilton Christiana (Newark) and Cafe on 26 (Ocean View) serve the beef.
